description.narrative: Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics (BBS) committed to incorporate disability module when they conduct Labour Force Survey (expected date January 2022, depending on COVID -19 situation). The ILO have conducted training of Labour Force Survey project team from BBS on Disability Inclusive Statistics. 81% of the participants indicted that they would like to apply the knowledge achieved from the training to the upcoming LFS. ILO technical experts have drafted the disability module in line with Washington Group Questions (WGQ) for the LFS. BBS accepted the module on disability with WGQ short set.
